entries.title: Genesis 37:1
segments: And Jacob lived in the land of the travels of his father, in the land of Canaan.

entries.title: Genesis 37:2
segments: These [are] the generations of Jacob: Joseph, a son of seventeen years, came tending the flock with his brothers. And he was a youth with the sons of Bilhah, and with the sons of Zilpah, his father's wives. And Joseph brought to his father an evil report of them.

entries.title: Genesis 37:3
segments: And Israel loved Joseph more than all his sons, because he was the son of his old age. And he made him a tunic [reaching to] the soles [of his] feet.

entries.title: Genesis 37:4
segments: And when his brothers saw that their father loved him more than all his brothers, they hated him, and could not speak peaceably to him.

entries.title: Genesis 37:5
segments: And Joseph dreamed a dream and told [it] to his brothers. And they hated him still more.

entries.title: Genesis 37:6
segments: And he said to them, I pray you, Hear this dream which I have dreamed.

entries.title: Genesis 37:7
segments: For behold! We [were] binding sheaves in the middle of the field, and lo, my sheaf arose and also stood upright. And behold, your sheaves stood around and bowed down to my sheaf.

entries.title: Genesis 37:8
segments: And his brothers said to him, Shall you indeed reign over us? Or shall you indeed have the rule over us? And they hated him still more for his dreams and for his words.

entries.title: Genesis 37:9
segments: And he dreamed still another dream, and told it to his brothers. And he said, Behold, I have dreamed another dream. And behold, the sun and the moon and the eleven stars bowed down to me.

entries.title: Genesis 37:10
segments: And he told [it] to his father and to his brothers. And his father rebuked him and said to him, What [is] this dream that you have dreamed? Shall I, and your mother, and your brothers indeed come to bow ourselves to the earth before you?

entries.title: Genesis 37:11
segments: And his brothers were jealous of him. But his father observed the saying.

entries.title: Genesis 37:12
segments: And his brothers went to feed his father's flock in Shechem.

entries.title: Genesis 37:13
segments: And Israel said to Joseph, Do not your brothers feed the flock in Shechem? Come, and I will send you to them. And he said to him, Here I [am].

entries.title: Genesis 37:14
segments: And he said to him, please go see whether it is well with your brothers and well with the flocks. And bring me word again. And he sent him out of the valley of Hebron, and he came to Shechem.

entries.title: Genesis 37:15
segments: And a certain man found him, and, behold, he was wandering in the field. And the man asked him, saying, What are you looking for?

entries.title: Genesis 37:16
segments: And he said, I [am] seeking for my brothers. Please tell me where they are feeding?

entries.title: Genesis 37:17
segments: And the man said, They are gone from here, for I heard [them] say, Let us go to Dothan. And Joseph went after his brothers, and found them in Dothan.

entries.title: Genesis 37:18
segments: And when they saw him afar off, even before he came near them, they conspired against him to kill him.

entries.title: Genesis 37:19
segments: And they said to one another, Behold, this dreamer comes.

entries.title: Genesis 37:20
segments: Therefore come now, and let us kill him, and throw him into some pit, and we will say some evil beast has devoured him. And we shall see what will become of his dreams.

entries.title: Genesis 37:21
segments: And Reuben heard, and [he] delivered him out of their hands and said, Let us not kill him.

entries.title: Genesis 37:22
segments: And Reuben said to them, Shed no blood. Throw him into this pit in the wilderness, and lay no hand upon him (in order to rescue him out of their hands, to deliver him to his father again).

entries.title: Genesis 37:23
segments: And it happened when Joseph had come to his brothers, they stripped Joseph out of his tunic, the tunic reaching to the soles [of his] feet that was on him.

entries.title: Genesis 37:24
segments: And they took him and threw him into a pit. And the pit [was] empty, with no water in it.

entries.title: Genesis 37:25
segments: And they sat down to eat bread. And they lifted up their eyes, and looked. And behold, a company of Ishmaelites came from Gilead, with their camels bearing spices and balm and myrrh, going to carry it down to Egypt.

entries.title: Genesis 37:26
segments: And Judah said to his brothers, What profit [is it] if we should kill our brother and hide his blood?

entries.title: Genesis 37:27
segments: Come, let us sell him to the Ishmaelites, and let not our hand be upon him. For he [is] our brother, and our flesh. And his brothers listened.

entries.title: Genesis 37:28
segments: And men, Midianites traders, came by. And they drew up Joseph and took him out of the pit, and sold Joseph to the Ishmaelites for twenty [pieces] of silver. And they brought Joseph into Egypt.

entries.title: Genesis 37:29
segments: And Reuben returned to the pit. And behold! Joseph [was] not in the pit! And he tore his clothes.

entries.title: Genesis 37:30
segments: And he returned to his brothers and said, The child, he is not. And I, where shall I go?

entries.title: Genesis 37:31
segments: And they took Joseph's tunic, and killed a kid of the goats, and dipped the tunic in the blood.

entries.title: Genesis 37:32
segments: And they sent the tunic [reaching to] the soles of the feet, and they brought it to their father. And they said, We have found this. Do you know whether it [is] your son's coat or not?

entries.title: Genesis 37:33
segments: And he knew it, and said, [It is] my son's tunic. An evil beast has eaten him. Joseph is without doubt torn in pieces.

entries.title: Genesis 37:34
segments: And Jacob tore his clothes, and put sackcloth upon his loins, and mourned for his son many days.

entries.title: Genesis 37:35
segments: And all his sons, and all his daughters, rose up to comfort him. But he refused to be comforted. And he said, For I will go down into the grave to my son mourning. And his father wept for him.

entries.title: Genesis 37:36
segments: And the Midianites sold him into Egypt to Potiphar, a eunuch of Pharaoh, the chief of the executioners.
